sentences.text: The current evidence shows the KFS lists only a processing fee, while the home loan agreement also includes a ₹500 documentation fee payable at execution.
The earlier KFS rule said fees not mentioned in the KFS could not be charged without the borrower’s explicit consent, but that rule is no longer in force as of 2026-11-23.
The current UCB Directions may govern fees not in the KFS, but applicability is still unknown because the sanction date is needed.
On the evidence provided, I cannot confirm that the ₹500 documentation fee may be charged without the missing sanction date and the related conditions under the current Directions.

missing.searched: Reviewed the current UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 fee rule applicability finding, but the code-verified finding says sanction_date is needed to decide whether the rule applies.
